text:
emma: FYI onboarding run for 'sparrow-lite-q3' v0.3.1 -> ~2% funcall parse failures, streaming path.
raj: only streaming?
emma: sync clean. streaming chunk boundaries correlate. sample 114477 reproducible.
sara: paste a failing capture?
emma: logged chunks:
```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"sourdough starter"}}

{"tool":"open_url","args":{"url":"http://recipes.example/bread"}}

]}
```
raj: stray closing bracket merged, parser errors on `]}`.
ci-bot: canary sparrow-lite-q3 v0.3.1 started at 1745119900 config: stream_chunk_size=512 kv_cache=on
mike: numbers?
emma: 10k canary calls -> 198 failures (1.98%). breakdown: 60% trailing-suffix, 30% controlchar, 10% reorder.
sara: hypothesis: quant tokenization shifted boundaries so cuts mid-structure more often.
raj: can we repro by forcing token splits?
emma: byte-split fuzzing repro: v0.3.1 ~90% for targeted splits vs baseline v0.2.9 ~4%.
mike: any cheap healer?
sara: propose streaming-rescue fallback: on parse fail try small heuristics: append cached openers, or try wrapping chunks into array and json.loads.
emma: prototype wrapper reduced failures to 0.6% in canary. patch example:
```python
wrapped = '[' + ','.join(filter(None, chunks)) + ']'
obj = json.loads(wrapped)
```
mike: watch semantics. need semantic-eval after salvage.
sara: add unit tests for truncated-suffix, controlchar, interleaved-tools and an integration fuzz job. redact logs but keep raw stream for audit.
raj: will push token-split repro harness and fuzz job today.
ci-bot: trial 1745120300 -> failure_rate 0.6% -> health improved
mike: rollout plan: behind flag, enable for q3 quant families only; monitor parsed_tool_count and semantic-eval-delta; rollback if semantic score drops >0.5%.
emma: opening PR, please monitor dashboards 48h. :eyes:
